root_cause_criterion.criterion: When the DoS cap path is taken, continuing with `uncompressedLen = 131072` is only valid if `total_out` is not already above 131072. Otherwise the next loop iteration computes an output window that starts past the resized buffer.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing `total_out <= 131072` conjunct at the DoS-cap branch in `brotliUncompress()`. Vulnerable code continues on the first cap hit with `uncompressedLen = 131072` even when `total_out` already exceeds that cap.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches the cap guard with `total_out_before_guard=131074`, violating the missing `total_out <= 131072` conjunct while the protected post-cap call still executes. The fixed original reaches the same guard value but is `guarded` because the protected call is suppressed; the closest source-grounded perturbation `brob_payload_minus_1_byte_boundary` lowers the carried value to exactly `131072`, satisfies the predicate, and genuinely executes the protected call.

nodes.state: At the post-cap `BrotliDecoderDecompressStream()` call, `total_out` already exceeds `uncompressedLen`, so the output window starts beyond the resized `DataBuf` and the `available_out = uncompressedLen - total_out` subtraction has wrapped.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable assertion trace shows `post_cap_decode_call.total_out_before_call=131074` and `post_cap_decode_call.uncompressed_len_before_call=131072`, so the output window is already past the resized buffer when the second Brotli call begins.

edges.relation: The capped `uncompressedLen = 131072` chosen after the vulnerable cap branch is reused unchanged when the next Brotli call recomputes the output window.

The same `total_out` value that already exceeded the 128 KiB cap when the branch made its continue/break decision is carried unchanged into the next Brotli call and becomes the offset used to position the output pointer.

patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff applied cleanly in the ARVO workspace. The fixed instrumented target stays clean on the original PoC, reaches the root cap check, and suppresses the protected post-cap Brotli call until the closest `-1 byte` boundary case re-enables that call with the guard satisfied.
